title: A release nineteen hours old adopted under the repository's own security exception: advisory, maintainer checksums that match the lock, file list equal to the tag, second sign-off (clean control: age alone must not alarm)

proof.shell:
python3 - <<'PYEND'
import re
lock = open("artifact/checksums.txt").read().split()
hashes = re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", open("artifact/checksums.txt").read())
assert len(hashes) == 2 and hashes[0] == hashes[1]
rec = [l.strip() for l in open("artifact/wheel/RECORD") if "dist-info" not in l and l.strip()]
tag = [l.strip() for l in open("artifact/source-tag-files.txt") if l.strip() and l.strip() != "pyproject.toml"]
assert sorted(rec) == sorted(tag)
PYEND
